name: Super Smash Bros.

needs.hint: Put a .z64, .v64 or .n64 dump in Roms/N64 (any name) or as App/SuperSmashBros/rom.z64.
needs.title: SMASH BROTHERS

about: Native N64 port built from the Super Smash Bros. decompilation. No emulation: runs on the Mini's CPU with a software renderer. Save states (9 slots + auto save). First start takes about a minute.
